thread:
Jordan: Quick sync — want to pilot a 6-week 'seed cohort' for early product-market fit testing. Goal: 8-10 teams that can ship an integration within 6 weeks.
Priya: Love it. What's the ask from PD/SE teams? timeline?
Evan: Recruitment target = 10 by Apr 10. We should prioritize companies with existing LLM infra.
Lina: Suggested incentives: 3-month free Dedicated credits + engineering office hours + joint case study.
Jordan: Agree. Also need clear feedback cadence: weekly 30-min syncs + asynchronous feedback via shared Notion and a short NPS at week 3/6.
Kai: Screening rubric draft:
```
- Must have >100k monthly requests or a clear business use-case
- Must commit engineering lead to 4h/week
- Data sensitivity: OK with sending non-PII to hosted service or can run private
- Integration: webhook or SDK within 2 weeks
```
Priya: Can product ops run the first 30 outreach emails? I can provide copy.
Lina: I can host the onboarding checklist + sample prompts. Will add to /templates.
Evan: Question: do we allow on-prem only customers? I'd say yes but mark as 'private track' and slower SLA.
Jordan: Launch criteria checklist (must pass all):
```
- 5 integrations completed and sending >=5000 tokens/day
- No major perf regressions (p50 < 250ms)
- Documented 2 case studies ready
- Feedback loop established (weekly + tickets triage)
```
Priya: Who's owning recruitment scoring? I'd volunteer to own shortlist.
Kai: I'll build a simple Airtable with columns: company, vertical, engineer_contact, commitment_score, timeline, notes.
Lina: Timeline: recruit by Apr 10, onboard Apr 17–21, pilot Apr 24–Jun 5.
Jordan: Action items: Priya — outreach; Kai — Airtable; Lina — onboarding checklist; Evan — docs for private-track deviations. I'll set up weekly steering meeting.
Priya: +1, will share draft email by EOD. :rocket: 
Evan: Heads-up: add 'rollback plan' for integrations that spike cost. small snippet for contracts: 'trial credits capped at $X/month'.
Jordan: Noted. Thanks team — will post the kickoff thread in #product later and ping legal for contract language.
